about_the_game:
Blast, Mutate, Survive... Repeat!


In a world ravaged beyond recognition, survival isn't just a goal – it's a brutal, chaotic dance against extinction. Hurl yourself into the fray of Boom Die Repeat, a relentless top-down roguelite where the apocalypse is your playground and death is merely the catalyst for your next, more powerful evolution.

Each desperate run plunges you into unique, randomized biomes teeming with ravenous zombies, twisted mutants, salvaged gear, and the constant threat of annihilation. Adapt your tactics on the fly, scavenge vital DNA to mutate your very being, and leverage every failure to stack up permanent perks. Can you push farther this time?

Key Features


  • Brutal Combat Against Zombies & Mutants: Face relentless hordes of undead and unpredictable, mutated horrors. Master dodging, precision shooting, and clever tactics to outsmart enemies that grow fiercer the deeper you venture and the longer you survive.

  • Explore Ever-Changing Biomes: Battle through diverse, procedurally generated apocalyptic landscapes – from the crumbling husks of cities and toxic swamps to overgrown jungles and desolate farmlands. Every run presents fresh layouts, enemy encounters, hidden secrets, and deadly surprises.

  • Unleash Unique Weapons & Insane Loadouts: Arm yourself with a wild arsenal, ranging from classic shotguns and rifles to experimental mutant-busting tech and devastating heavy ordnance. Customize your chaos with game-changing equipment – deploy automated turrets, call down crackling lightning strikes, utilize explosive decoys, and more to turn the tide!

  • Mutate and Grow Stronger: Harvest vital DNA from fallen foes and inject it to unlock bizarre and powerful mutations mid-run. Will you develop ricocheting bullets, a corrosive touch, or perhaps trigger devastating explosions on critical hits? Stack mutations to create truly game-breaking synergies and embrace the evolution!

  • Permanent Upgrades for Endless Progression: Death is not defeat, but opportunity. Invest resources scavenged from your runs into permanent upgrades enhancing your core strength, speed, health, and unlocking potent new abilities. Unlock new starting options, powerful global perks, and expand your strategic possibilities for future attempts.

  • Infinite Replayability: With randomized biomes, countless mutation combinations, vast weapon drops, and dynamic enemy waves, no two runs are ever the same. Discover new strategies, overcome escalating challenges, and dive back in again and again for a fresh dose of apocalyptic mayhem.

Will You Adapt... or Become Another Corpse?


The wasteland demands evolution. Mutate, upgrade, and push deeper into the heart of the apocalypse with every cycle of death and rebirth. Every failure fuels your future strength.

Gear up, embrace the madness, and carve your legend into the ruins of the old world. The ultimate challenge awaits!

short_description: Blast zombies & mutants in this fast-paced post-apocalyptic top-down roguelite! Battle through randomized biomes, swap out unique weapons, equip insane loadouts, and mutate yourself stronger with collected DNA. Die, unlock permanent perks, and dive back into another brutal run!
